label: Quick create
description: A button that opens a compact create form for an entity in a dialog, with only the listed fields, such as "New child ticket" on a ticket. Data rules apply as on any other write. On a record view, a lookup from the new record to the current one is prefilled.
usage: List only the fields needed to start (2–5); people can complete the rest later.
Use a label that says what is created ("New child ticket").
Use a spec_object.form view with action.button quick_create:<id> when the form needs layout.
constraints: entity must exist; fields (1–8) must be writable fields of it.
Every required field of the entity that is not listed must have a default, or compilation fails.
Shown only to viewers with create permission on the entity; data-scoped rules apply, form-scoped rules of other views do not.

binding.description: Creates a record of entity; prefills a lookup to the page's record when one exists.

accessibility.keyboard: Enter or Space opens the dialog; focus moves to the first field; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter creates; Esc cancels and returns focus.
accessibility.notes: The dialog is role=dialog labelled by label, with a focus trap.

responsive: Opens as a centered dialog on desktop and a full-screen sheet below 720px.
